snippet.title: BIRD GAME 3 (OFFICIAL TRAILER)
snippet.description:
ITS TIME 😈 The Official Bird Game 3 trailer is here.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4223300/Bird_Game_3/ 
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/birdgame 

Bird Game 3 is a multiplayer bird-based PvP game with unfiltered proximity chat, flying, and combat. We’re early in development and everything you see is a WIP. More updates and features coming soon.
Tell us what features you want in the comments!
